node.name: spawn_entity
node.args: -topic=/robot_description -entity $(var entity_name) -x $(var init_x_position) -y $(var init_y_position) -z $(var init_z_position) -R $(var init_roll_angle) -P $(var init_pitch_angle) -Y $(var init_yaw_angle)

node.name: spawn_light_source_1
node.args: -file $(var light_source_1_model_filepath) -entity $(var light_source_1_entity_name) -x $(var light_1_x) -y $(var light_1_y) -z $(var light_source_1_z) -R $(var light_source_1_roll) -P $(var light_source_1_pitch) -Y $(var light_source_1_yaw)

executable.cmd: ros2 run ros_esc encoder_node /joint_states $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/encoder_chatter --joint_names $(var joint_name_1)
ros2 run ros_esc rotate_frame_node $(var entity_name)/encoder_chatter $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var rotate_frame_config_filepath)
ros2 run ros_esc sensor_pose_node /odom $(var entity_name)/encoder_chatter $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/sensor_transform_chatter $(var sensor_transform_config_filepath)

ros2 run ros_esc cost_function_node $(var entity_name)/sensor_transform_chatter $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/cost_value_chatter $(var cost_function_config_filepath) --light_source_count $(var number_of_lights) --light_source_1_x $(var light_1_x) --light_source_1_y $(var light_1_y) --light_source_1_intensity_lumens $(var light_1_intensity_lumens) --light_source_2_x $(var light_2_x) --light_source_2_y $(var light_2_y) --light_source_2_intensity_lumens $(var light_2_intensity_lumens) --light_source_3_x $(var light_3_x) --light_source_3_y $(var light_3_y) --light_source_3_intensity_lumens $(var light_3_intensity_lumens) --light_source_4_x $(var light_4_x) --light_source_4_y $(var light_4_y) --light_source_4_intensity_lumens $(var light_4_intensity_lumens) --light_source_5_x $(var light_5_x) --light_source_5_y $(var light_5_y) --light_source_5_intensity_lumens $(var light_5_intensity_lumens)

ros2 run ros_esc cost_surface_plotter $(var cost_function_config_filepath) --x-min $(var cost_surface_x_min) --x-max $(var cost_surface_x_max) --y-min $(var cost_surface_y_min) --y-max $(var cost_surface_y_max) --resolution $(var cost_surface_resolution) --orientation-mode $(var cost_surface_orientation_mode) --z-scale-mode $(var cost_surface_z_scale_mode) --show-base-wireframe $(var cost_surface_show_base_wireframe) --live $(var cost_surface_live) --odom-topic $(var cost_surface_odom_topic) --fill-topic $(var cost_surface_fill_topic) --refresh-hz $(var cost_surface_refresh_hz) --trajectory-period $(var cost_surface_trajectory_period) --output-dir $(var cost_surface_output_dir) --output-latest-test-dir $(var cost_surface_output_latest_test_dir) --dpi $(var cost_surface_dpi) --light_source_count $(var number_of_lights) --light_source_1_x $(var light_1_x) --light_source_1_y $(var light_1_y) --light_source_1_intensity_lumens $(var light_1_intensity_lumens) --light_source_2_x $(var light_2_x) --light_source_2_y $(var light_2_y) --light_source_2_intensity_lumens $(var light_2_intensity_lumens) --light_source_3_x $(var light_3_x) --light_source_3_y $(var light_3_y) --light_source_3_intensity_lumens $(var light_3_intensity_lumens) --light_source_4_x $(var light_4_x) --light_source_4_y $(var light_4_y) --light_source_4_intensity_lumens $(var light_4_intensity_lumens) --light_source_5_x $(var light_5_x) --light_source_5_y $(var light_5_y) --light_source_5_intensity_lumens $(var light_5_intensity_lumens)

ros2 run ros_esc modified_cost_node $(var entity_name)/cost_value_chatter /cost_bias /cost_modified --input_sensor_transform_topic $(var entity_name)/sensor_transform_chatter --input_odom_topic /odom --ros-args -p enable_affine_bias:=$(var modified_cost_enable_affine_bias) -p affine_gain:=$(var modified_cost_affine_gain) -p affine_decay_rate:=$(var modified_cost_affine_decay_rate) -p affine_max_age:=$(var modified_cost_affine_max_age) -p affine_direction_sign:=$(var modified_cost_affine_direction_sign) -p use_pde_history_for_affine:=$(var modified_cost_use_pde_history_for_affine) -p history_exclusion_radius_factor:=$(var modified_cost_history_exclusion_radius_factor) -p history_direction_mode:=$(var modified_cost_history_direction_mode)
ros2 run ros_esc pde_history_node --ros-args -p omega:=$(var pde_omega)
ros2 run ros_esc pde_cost_history_node --ros-args -p omega:=$(var pde_omega) -p cost_topic:=$(var pde_cost_history_topic)

ros2 run ros_esc convergence_detector_node --ros-args -p omega:=$(var pde_omega) -p threshold:=$(var convergence_threshold) -p decay_rate:=$(var convergence_decay_rate) -p min_fill_periods:=$(var convergence_min_fill_periods)

ros2 run ros_esc gaussian_fill_node --ros-args -p escape_policy:=$(var escape_policy) -p amplitude:=$(var gaussian_fill_amplitude) -p min_sigma:=$(var gaussian_fill_min_sigma) -p max_sigma:=$(var gaussian_fill_max_sigma) -p min_points:=$(var gaussian_fill_min_points) -p use_recent_fraction:=$(var gaussian_fill_use_recent_fraction) -p max_fills:=$(var gaussian_fill_max_fills) -p fill_cooldown_sec:=$(var gaussian_fill_cooldown_sec) -p min_distance_between_fills:=$(var gaussian_fill_min_distance_between_fills) -p min_event_center_distance_between_fills:=$(var gaussian_fill_min_event_center_distance_between_fills) -p center_source:=$(var gaussian_fill_center_source) -p max_fit_center_distance_from_event:=$(var gaussian_fill_max_fit_center_distance_from_event)

ros2 run ros_esc filter_node $(var entity_name)/cost_value_chatter $(var entity_name)/encoder_chatter $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/filter_value_chatter --filter_file $(var filter_config_filepath) --append_encoder_data $(var input_encoder_data_to_filter)

ros2 run ros_esc filter_node /cost_modified $(var entity_name)/encoder_chatter $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/filter_value_chatter --filter_file $(var filter_config_filepath) --append_encoder_data $(var input_encoder_data_to_filter)

ros2 run ros_esc controller_node $(var entity_name)/filter_value_chatter /odom $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter $(var entity_name)/control_value_chatter /cmd_vel $(var controller_config_filepath)

ros2 run ros_esc data_collection_node $(var data_collection_filepath) $(var rotate_frame_config_filepath) $(var sensor_transform_config_filepath) $(var cost_function_config_filepath) $(var filter_config_filepath) $(var controller_config_filepath) $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter /odom $(var entity_name)/sensor_transform_chatter $(var entity_name)/cost_value_chatter $(var entity_name)/filter_value_chatter $(var entity_name)/control_value_chatter $(var live_plot_mode)

ros2 run ros_esc data_collection_node $(var data_collection_filepath) $(var rotate_frame_config_filepath) $(var sensor_transform_config_filepath) $(var cost_function_config_filepath) $(var filter_config_filepath) $(var controller_config_filepath) $(var entity_name)/timekeeper_chatter /odom $(var entity_name)/sensor_transform_chatter /cost_modified $(var entity_name)/filter_value_chatter $(var entity_name)/control_value_chatter $(var live_plot_mode)
